story_title: Lina and Adams and the Kind Words
title: Lina and Adams and the Kind Words 💐 | Learn Polite Words in English for Kids | Moon Tales Kids
description:
Lina and Adams learn the magic of kind words at school and at home! 🙏💐🤗
In this English story for kids, children learn 7 new words: please, thank you, sorry, kind, friend, smile and hug. Listen, repeat, and learn English with Lina, Adams and Milo the cat.

📚 New words in this story:
🙏 please — من فضلك — s'il te plaît
💐 thank you — شكرا — merci
😔 sorry — آسف — pardon / désolé
🧡 kind — لطيف — gentil
👫 friend — صديق — ami / amie
😊 smile — ابتسامة — sourire
🤗 hug — عناق — câlin

👨‍👩‍👧 For parents: practise saying please, thank you and sorry together every day. Pause after each new word and say it out loud. Perfect for ages 3 to 8 and for children learning English as a second language.

🇲🇦 قصة باللغة الإنجليزية للأطفال لتعلم الكلمات اللطيفة والأخلاق الحميدة.
🇫🇷 Une histoire en anglais pour enfants pour apprendre les mots gentils et la politesse.

🌙 Subscribe to Moon Tales Kids for a new English story every day!

lines.text: Good morning! Lina and Adams are at school today.
On the board, the teacher wrote a word: please.
Lina, I want to draw a picture. Can I have the red crayon, please?
Yes, of course! Here you are.
When we ask for something nicely, we say please.
Say it with me: please!
Please is a magic word. It makes people happy to help.
Adams takes the red crayon from Lina.
Thank you, Lina!
You are welcome, Adams!
When someone gives us something or helps us, we say thank you.
Can you say it? Thank you!
Now Adams draws a big red apple.
Look, Lina! My apple is round and red.
Oops! Adams moves his arm, and his cup of water falls.
Splash! Water goes on Lina's drawing.
Oh no! My flower picture is wet.
Oh, Lina, I am so sorry. It was an accident.
When we make a mistake or hurt someone, we say sorry.
Say it with me: sorry!
It's okay, Adams. Thank you for saying sorry.
Lina, can I help you make a new picture, please?
Yes, please! Let's draw together.
Adams gives Lina his best paper. They draw a new flower together.
Adams is kind. Kind means you are nice and gentle with others.
Can you say it? Kind!
Adams, you are so kind!
And you are kind too, Lina!
The new picture is beautiful. It has a flower and a big heart.
This is the best picture! We made it together.
Because we are friends!
A friend is someone you like, and you play and share with.
Say it with me: friend!
You are my best friend, Adams.
You are my best friend too, Lina!
After school, Lina and Adams walk home with their families.
The sun is going down. The sky is orange and gold.
An old neighbour is sitting outside his house.
Good evening! How are you today?
The neighbour looks very happy. He has a big smile on his face.
A smile is when your mouth goes up, like this, because you are happy.
Can you smile? Say it with me: smile!
Lina, your smile is so big today!
Kind words make me smile.
Lina and Adams smile at everyone they see on the street.
And everyone smiles back at them!
Smiles are like little gifts. We can give one to everybody!
And they don't cost anything!
Smile, smile, smile. Everybody is happy.
At home, Lina and Adams are hungry after school.
Milo the cat is waiting for them in the kitchen. Meow!
Can we have a sandwich, please?
A sandwich is ready on the table. Yummy!
Thank you! It looks delicious.
Milo looks at the sandwich too. Meow, meow!
Sorry, Milo. Sandwiches are not for cats. Here is your fish food!
After dinner, Milo is sitting alone in the corner.
Milo looks a little bit lonely.
Let's give him a hug!
Lina and Adams wrap their arms around Milo, softly and gently.
When we put our arms around someone we love, it is a hug.
Can you hug yourself? Say it with me: hug!
Purr, purr, purr. Meow!
Lina, let's remember all our kind words!
Please, when we ask for something.
Thank you, when someone helps us.
Sorry, when we make a mistake.
And kind, friend, smile and hug!
Milo jumps on the chair. Meow! He knows kind words too.
Kind words make every day a happy day.
It is bedtime. The moon is shining in the window.
Thank you for a wonderful day, Adams.
Thank you, Lina. And thank you, Milo!
Milo gives a little purr and closes his eyes.
Good night, my friend.
Good night! Sweet dreams!
Tomorrow, they will use their kind words again. Good night!
